title: ISR Byte Ring With Critical Sections
shortDescription: Implement an ISR producer ring buffer with locked main-loop reads.

templates.notes: Treat push as ISR context. Main-loop pop and size must use the critical-section hooks.

visibleCases.name: size locks once
isr push then pop
visibleCases.displayExpect:
a = true
b = true
p1 = true
p2 = true
out1 = 0x11
out2 = 0x22
ISR pushes enter no critical sections
test_lock_enters() = 2
test_lock_exits() = 2
test_lock_depth() = 0
test_lock_errors() = 0
visibleCases.explanation: ISR producer does not lock; main-loop pop does.

visibleCases.name: full buffer rejects push
visibleCases.displayExpect:
All eight initial pushes return true
overflow = false
size = 8
test_lock_enters() = 1
test_lock_exits() = 1
test_lock_errors() = 0
visibleCases.explanation: The fixed buffer cannot overwrite unread data.

visibleCases.name: wrap-around fifo
visibleCases.displayExpect:
All six final pops return true
popped = {3, 4, 5, 100, 101, 102}
irq_ring_size(&rb) = 0
test_lock_errors() = 0
visibleCases.explanation: Head and tail must wrap independently.

hiddenCases.name: empty pop locks
hiddenCases.explanation: Empty checks still read shared state.

hiddenCases.name: push never locks
hiddenCases.explanation: ISR path should not attempt to mask interrupts again.

hiddenCases.name: many pops balanced
hiddenCases.displayExpect: one balanced critical section per pop
hiddenCases.explanation: Catches missing exits and double-enter bugs.

hiddenCases.name: size after wrap
hiddenCases.explanation: Size should be a protected snapshot, not a recomputed guess.

hiddenCases.name: reuse after drain
hiddenCases.explanation: State must recover cleanly after empty.
